name: BF-Agent-Ledger
author: BeforeUgone
description: AI coding usage on one page: limits, a year of activity, cost at list prices, and tokens by agent, model, project, hour and session for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes, Gemini CLI, Grok, Kigi, Devin, Kimi Code and Fireworks. English and Chinese.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one page for every AI coding subscription: rate-limit meters, a GitHub-style activity calendar, plan capacity, estimated cost, and a range-filtered breakdown by agent, model, project, hour and session. Sections can be reordered or hidden, and the page switches between English and Chinese.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: Calendar weeks
schema.description: How far back the activity calendar reaches. Fewer weeks draw larger cells.

schema.label: Sections
schema.description: Comma-separated, drawn in this order; leave one out to hide it. The panel's "Customize sections" button edits this. Available: summary, heatmap, limits, capacity, trend, agents, models, projects, breakdown, hours, sessions.

schema.label: Rows per list
schema.description: How many models, projects and sessions each list shows.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: The panel's language. The EN / 中 switch at the top of the panel sets this.
